questions.q: What is the API rate limit per key for Enterprise-plan customers?
questions.answer: 600 requests per minute per API key, with a burst of 100.

questions.q: What exactly was wrong with the label on cough syrup batch CR-2309?
questions.doc: Recall Report – Cough Syrup Batch CR-2309
questions.evidence: manufacturing licence number of Unit I (Ahmedabad) instead of Unit II (Baddi)
questions.answer: The bottle label carried the manufacturing licence number of Unit I (Ahmedabad) instead of Unit II (Baddi); all other label information was correct, so there was no safety impact.

questions.q: What HbA1c reduction did SJ-2041 show at the Phase III interim analysis?
questions.evidence: HbA1c change from baseline of −1.1% with SJ-2041 versus −0.6% with comparator
questions.answer: −1.1% with SJ-2041 versus −0.6% with the comparator (difference −0.5%), with a dropout rate of 7.4% and 2 serious adverse events judged unrelated.

questions.q: How many credit days does a stockist get?
questions.answer: 30 days from invoice date (15 days for a new stockist in its first 6 months).

questions.q: When are supplies stopped for overdue payments?
questions.evidence: i.e. 45 days from invoice for a stockist on 30-day terms
questions.answer: When any invoice is more than 15 days overdue (45 days from invoice on 30-day terms), when outstanding exceeds the credit limit by more than 10%, after a dishonoured cheque/NACH, or if the drug licence has expired.
